- **NEVER reset owner password without explicit owner approval** — owner was angry when password was reset to a generated value without asking

- Render deploy API: same endpoint with `{action: "render_trigger_deploy", input: {}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY"}`
- Render restart API: `{action: "render_restart_service", input: {}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE"}`

- **`/tmp/owner_at.json` can be wiped unexpectedly** — always check file exists and re-mint if missing
- Correct API host is `https://api.ivxholding.com` (NOT `https://ivxholding.com` which returns HTML)
- Health endpoint: `GET https://api.ivxholding.com/health` returns `{commit, status}` — use to verify deploy propagation
- `bun test backend/` = **1722 pass / 0 fail (6266 expects)** (stable across all fixes)
- Bash commands must complete under 60s or timeout; Render propagation ~2-5 min; use nohup background + poll for long ops
- Clean sandbox has NO `node_modules` — must run `bun install` before tests or tsc; must run in BOTH `/home/user/rork-app` AND `/home/user/rork-app/expo`
- `watchman` disabled (renamed to `/usr/local/bin/watchman.disabled`) to prevent Metro/Gradle build hangs
- **MFA must be optional, OFF by default** — owner was very angry it was enforced
- **Chat endpoint `/api/ivx/owner-ai` expects `body.message` (NOT `messages`)** — this is where `classifyExecutionModeIntent` runs and sets `executionMode: 'code_change'`; worker endpoint `/api/ivx/senior-developer/worker/jobs` does NOT set executionMode (jobs default to CONTENT_REQUEST)
- **Worker submit endpoint**: `POST /api/ivx/senior-developer/worker/jobs` with `{goal, prompt, requestsDeploy}` — returns `{ok, job:{jobId, status, stage}}`
- **Chat endpoint**: `POST /api/ivx/owner-ai` with `{message, conversationId}` — calls `classifyExecutionModeIntent`, returns `{executionStatus:{taskId, status, stage, liveProgress, statusUrl}}`
